bespoke_exceptions: Program arrays vary from 2 to 10 entries; repeated atomic reported_program records suffice.
Related-party disclosure is a disclosure-status satellite, not a governance-quality inference.
AIS purpose prose remains a quoted reported description; no impact/outcome classification was attempted.
adapter_changes: none; consumed retained acnc-ais-detail representation directly
review_burden: one proposition and exact JSON pointer; 106 candidate review units plus 24 coverage abstentions
strongest_evidence_against_hypothesis: Structured AIS supports many atomic spine records but compresses relationships, measurement methodology, temporal program changes and full financial-statement context into satellites or coverage gaps; it cannot by itself make a richly explanatory card.
